h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bilaspur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bilaspur

c: Bilaspur is the second big city of Chhattisgarh, the seat of the state High Court and the headquarters of a railway zone, with large government and railway colonies as a result. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bilaspur to those colonies and to schools, colleges, municipal parks and private housing. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,010 km away, and sent by road.

Colony buyers usually work through a committee or an estate office, and they want a clear list of what they are paying for. Our quote names every machine, and the layout drawing shows where it goes and how much clear space it needs. That makes approval easier. The weather in Bilaspur is very hot before the monsoon and quite wet during it, so we build with galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts and grout the machines on open ground.
Combination frames give a committee more exercises for each footing. The
Leg Press Cum Fun Walker Cum Seating Twister
has a leg press, an air walker and a seated twister on one frame. Pair it with the
, which works the arms and legs together in a riding motion. These three cover most of what residents of all ages will want.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.a: Each machine by name, with quantity, plus installation details. The layout drawing shows the position and clear zone of every machine. Send us the site size and photos to begin.

items.q: Do you supply railway colonies in Bilaspur?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai and install with our own team or a dealer in central India. The estate office can send the park size and photos to sales@funplaysystems.com.

items.q: How long is the warranty on frames and bearings?
items.a: Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. Both cover manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and maintained as advised.
